label: Delimiter and first few copy steps of long sequences
explanation: Almost never active during the original phase (6 of 646k steps). Active at the <DEL> step and the first ~3 copy steps (recall_idx 0-3 hold ~99% of mass), mostly when many outputs remain (to_go 6-8) and so mostly for L>=7; L=9 holds 47% of mass. Recall is high (mass recall ~0.9 on dev), but precision is very low (~6%): only about 5% of delimiter steps fire. Which of those early copy-window steps fire depends on what the sequence contains: rates are higher when the sequence includes k, l, w, d or y (in_orig k ~1.5x), and lower when it has many digits. Top activations are often on a copied k/w/o at recall_idx 1-2. Token-set predicates I tried did not push F1 past ~0.19, so the content dependence is distributed and not captured. Not active on original-phase inputs or on late copy steps.
